name: Crawling Sensation
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may mill two cards. (You may put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)
Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.

needs.what: an ordinal on `put_into_graveyard` (like `nth` on `draw` and `spell_cast`): a per-player turn-ledger count of the simultaneous groups that put one or more cards matching the trigger's filter (here: land cards) into that player's graveyard, so `nth: 1` fires on the first such group of the turn and never on a later one -- including when the first group happened before this enchantment was on the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `put_into_graveyard` with `batched: true`, `controller: "you"` and `filter: {"types": ["Land"]}` expresses "whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere" exactly, but "for the first time each turn" is not `max_per_turn: 1`: the cap counts this permanent's own firings, so a Crawling Sensation cast after a land was already milled or discarded that turn would still make an Insect. `nth` is read only on draw and spell_cast, and `cards_to_graveyard_this_turn` is a bare count over every graveyard and every card type. The upkeep `may` + `mill` line and insect_1_1_g are expressible today.
